name: codex-gate
description: Pre-PR gate: rounds of adversarial Codex review (gstack /codex) and agent fixes, run locally before a PR to dev or main is opened, with a live progress pane.

maxRounds.title: Max review rounds
maxRounds.description: How many Codex review rounds to run before the gate stops trying to converge.

advisoryMinRounds.title: Min advisory rounds
advisoryMinRounds.description: Once no high/critical finding is left, Codex's other findings (P2/P3) go back to the fixer. Up to this round, a rebuttal that changes no code still goes back to Codex for its answer.

advisoryMaxRounds.title: Max advisory rounds
advisoryMaxRounds.description: How many rounds of advisory findings the fixer is sent before the PR opens with whatever is left. 0 skips advisories. These rounds are on top of the max review rounds.

bases.title: Gated base branches
bases.description: Comma-separated base branches whose PRs must pass the gate first. The first one is the default base.

enforce.title: Block ungated PRs
enforce.description: Deny `gh pr create` (and the GitHub MCP create-PR tool) to a gated base until the gate has finished for the current HEAD, and start the gate when one is denied.

fixer.title: Who fixes findings
fixer.description: main sends each round's findings back to the main agent; subagent hands them to a fresh sub-agent.

fixReview.title: Review the fix before the next round
fixReview.description: A separate sub-agent checks the fix commits before Codex sees them again. auto does this only for high blast-radius changes.

onExhausted.title: After the last round without agreement
onExhausted.description: open-pr opens the PR anyway and says the gate did not converge (counts only, no finding details); stop leaves the PR blocked for a human decision.

openPr.title: Ask the main agent to open the PR
openPr.description: When the gate finishes, prompt the main agent to push and open the PR following the repository's own rules.

highRiskPaths.title: High blast-radius paths
highRiskPaths.description: A regular expression over changed file paths. A match raises the tier to high: Codex challenge mode runs in parallel with the review, Codex starts at high effort, and fixes are reviewed before the next round. A submodule pointer to a commit already on that submodule's origin/main or origin/dev is not counted.

reviewEffort.title: Codex effort, standard changes
reviewEffort.description: The reasoning effort Codex starts at on a change that is not high blast radius. A high blast-radius change (highRiskPaths, or a large diff) always starts at high. When Codex times out, the round reruns one level lower, down to low; the next run on that branch starts a level below where the timed-out one ended.

lightBranches.title: Light-lane branches
lightBranches.description: A regular expression over the branch name. A matching branch gets one Codex round and no advisory rounds; whatever Codex raises goes to the pull request's own review. A pointer bump, version-only bump or already-landed commits pass without Codex on any branch. Empty turns the light lane off.

lightEffort.title: Codex effort, light-lane branches
lightEffort.description: The effort Codex starts at on a light-lane branch that is not high blast radius. A high blast-radius change still starts at high.

stepTimeoutMinutes.title: Step timeout (minutes)
stepTimeoutMinutes.description: How long one agent step may run before the gate stops with an error.
